<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/track/"}

>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Public parcel tracking for the web app and the AfriBox website. Requires the parcel `reference` **and** the last four digits of the recipient's phone (`phone4`) as a second factor; a wrong reference and a wrong phone both return `07` (the endpoint never confirms whether a reference exists). Returns only the current status and its history (status + timestamp) — names, addresses, phone numbers, locker numbers and opening codes are never returned. Staff and business names are not disclosed. Rate-limited; do not use it to enumerate references.
